messages:
alice (eng-platform): Heads-up — I'm kicking off the token unit-econ dashboard project. We need runtime+infra inputs: cost per 1K tokens, cache hit savings (prefix + KV), batching delta (cost & latency), and p95 token latency. Who can own the ingestion schema for runtime metrics?
ben (eng-runtime): I can take the runtime side. Quick Q: do you want cost computed upstream (in runtime) or in analytics? both have tradeoffs.
carol (product-analytics): Prefer raw ingest and compute in analytics so we can slice by route/model/region. also need consistent cardinality keys: customer_id, model_id, route, deployment_variant.
dave (eng-infra): Infra can expose GPU cost per-second and host-level metrics. We already export allocation_time and GPU-seconds to prometheus, but token accounting lives in runtime. We'll need a join key.
emma (console-ux): UX note — dashboard needs fast breakdowns: overall cost per 1k, then toggles for cache-only / batch-only savings. Keep top-level numbers small: unit_cost_1k, percent_saved_cache, percent_saved_batch.
alice (eng-platform): So action items: @ben add token counters & cache hits to telemetry events; @dave confirm cost-per-gpu-second mapping; @carol define computed fields in the data platform. Agree? :thumbsup:
ben (eng-runtime): I'll add two fields to request telemetry: tokens_generated (int) and cache_lookup ("miss"|"hit"|"partial"). Proposed event snippet:```json
{"event":"request_summary","ts":1776543210,"customer_id":"cust_123","model_id":"open-7b","route":"/v1/generate","tokens_generated":128,"cache_lookup":"hit","batch_size":4,"latencies":{"server_p95_ms":45}}```
carol (product-analytics): That looks good. For analytics we'll compute: unit_cost_1k = (sum(gpu_cost) + infra_overhead) / (sum(tokens)/1000). Also will calculate cache_savings = baseline_cost - actual_cost where baseline assumes cache miss. I'll write the SQL UDFs.
dave (eng-infra): I can push a mapping table for gpu_type -> cost_per_gpu_second into the metrics org. We'll timestamp the mapping and include allocation_id in runtime telemetry so you can join.
emma (console-ux): One more: make sure batch_size included and a boolean for is_streaming to render different charts. Small mock for the dashboard wireframe: top row: total cost per 1k, total tokens, cache save %; middle: time series; bottom: breakdown by model/route.
alice (eng-platform): Agree. Can we get a PoC ingest for next Tue? Ben/dave/carol status?
ben (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR today adding telemetry fields and an e2e test that emits the event.
dave (eng-infra): I'll add the cost mapping and expose allocation_id by EOD tomorrow.
carol (product-analytics): I'll draft the SQL and a Looker/Metabase dataset by Monday.
telemetry-bot: new schema registered: request_summary_v1 (fields: customer_id, model_id, route, tokens_generated, cache_lookup, batch_size, server_p95_ms, allocation_id).
alice (eng-platform): Awesome. Emma, you'll want to mock data for UX?
emma (console-ux): Yep — I can take a slice of synthetic data from Carol's dataset and wire up the prototype.
alice (eng-platform): Great. I'll track in the project board and ping this thread for blockers. Thanks all :rocket:
